sources.application: Reviewed torque/motor/limit separation. Active arms retain authored muscle tone and only a small bounded physical tracking residual.

Inspected quaternion swing/twist decomposition and separate angular limits. Implemented an independent joint-local projection for the native skeleton, also after rendered crossfades. No Jolt library or source was imported.
Verified 38-video dataset description and 3D annotation layout. Complete dataset resides on Google Drive, previously unavailable; no new 3D clips obtained.
Reviewed feature-search and dataset requirements. Original native animation search and source accounting are retained; no unlicensed motion database was imported.
Reviewed target-pose conversion, bounded exponential maps and PD control interface. No trained controller, weights or motion clips imported.

visual_reference.status: Previously digitized approximate projected keyposes; no new 3D inference performed.

motion_inventory.description: Procedural references are not independent filmed performances.

anatomical_limits.status: Prototype constraints for this specific native skeleton, including scapular allowance; not clinical measurements.

limits: Native locomotion and foot contact selection remain authored; this is not a learned whole-body muscle policy.
Body collisions use capsule/elliptic proxies; no global triangle-pair nonintersection proof.
No claim of hundreds of thousands of independently captured or reconstructed animations.
Windows is cross-compiled; rendered regression tests execute in Linux with a virtual Xbox device.
